description: Search file contents or find files by name. Use this instead of grep/rg/find/ls in terminal. Ripgrep-backed, faster than shell equivalents.
name: search_files

context.description: Content search only: lines of context before and after each match.

file_glob.description: Content search only: filter files by pattern (e.g. '*.py').

offset.description: Skip first N results for pagination.

order.description: File search only: 'discovery' is fast bounded traversal order; 'modified' is exact global newest-first and may scan the full tree.

output_mode.description: Content search only: 'content' shows matching lines with line numbers, 'files_only' lists file paths, 'count' shows match counts per file.

path.description: Directory or file to search in.

pattern.description: Regex for content search; glob (e.g. '*.py', '*config*') for file search.

target.description: 'content' searches inside files, 'files' finds files by name.
